item_short_desc: Rothco’s Black & Gold Army Flag is the perfect way to show your pride. Measuring 3 feet by 5 feet, this flag is constructed from high-quality, durable polyester material that can withstand outdoor elements, ensuring long-lasting use. The classic black and gold design stands out whether you display it outside your home, on a flagpole, or indoors. The flag features reinforced grommets, allowing for easy attachment to flagpoles or hanging on walls.
